surfaces.title: Personal login
surfaces.scope: Password and one-time-code entry into a personal authenticated session.

surfaces.title: Login to dashboard
surfaces.scope: A fresh staff browser session authenticates and reaches the expected dashboard.

receipts.method: Executed the exact login route with a permitted test account and confirmed the authenticated destination.
receipts.limitations: This receipt does not execute JavaScript, prove responsive layout, or cover shared-device login.
receipts.truth_boundary: The receipt proves only the named route, role, environment, method, and evidence tier.

truth_boundary: Forge maps exact package surfaces to explicit receipts without inferring that route existence proves database, authentication, browser, device, staging, production, or deployment behavior.
